verdict.rationale: Helicone's pricing page claims it 'is open-source', llms.txt brands it 'Helicone OSS', and a public GitHub repo plus self-host docs show the source is readable. A community report concretely contradicts the 'open license' part: Helicone used the Commons Clause, which isn't typically considered an open source license, and this was raised on GitHub. missing for 10: evidence naming the current license (e.g. a LICENSE file stating an OSI-approved license), independent confirmation that the Commons Clause restriction was removed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
